propositions: The outbound mapper currently injects an assignee resolver via direct attribute assignment with a silent try/except fallback, making failures invisible and creating dead code paths in backends that forbid attribute injection.
Type checkers cannot validate the injected attribute dependency, requiring type: ignore comments and preventing detection of missing resolver wiring.

The resolver dependency must be threaded explicitly through the OutboundMapper.resolve_assignee contract signature as a keyword-only parameter, replacing all attribute-injection and getattr-discovery patterns.
DC's constructor-bound resolver must be preserved as a fallback in _DCOutbound while allowing core-supplied resolvers to take precedence, maintaining current overwrite semantics.
All six-state parity tests and backend characterization tests must produce identical observable outcomes after refactoring to explicit parameter passing.
